source_refs.note: Exercise 14.2, Question 11: total work of three constant forces equals 102 Nm (book p.275). Verified; the key gives no separate answer.

blocks.prompt: 11. A particle is displaced from the point \(A(5, -5, -7)\) to the point \(B(6, 2, -2)\). Under the action of constant forces defined by \(10\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 11\underline{k}\), \(4\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 9\underline{k}\) and \(-2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 9\underline{k}\). Show that the total work done by the force is 102 Nm.
blocks.explanation:
Is dafa teen constant forces ek saath lag rahi hain aur humein dikhana hai ke kul work 102 Nm hai.
Diya kya hai? Teen forces aur do points.
Saabit kya karna hai? \(W = 102\) Nm.
Plan: teeno forces jama, phir \(\underline{AB}\), phir dot product, aur dekhein ke 102 aata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya hai: forces \(10\underline{i} - \underline{j} + 11\underline{k}\), \(4\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 9\underline{k}\), \(-2\underline{i} + \underline{j} - 9\underline{k}\); particle \(A(5, -5, -7)\) se \(B(6, 2, -2)\) tak.
Saabit karna hai: kul work \(= 102\) Nm.
Tareeqa: Constant force ka work done \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\) hai (14.2.8). Work sirf force ke us hisse se hota hai jo harkat ki simt mein ho, yani \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta\), aur use faasle se multiply karte hain: \(|\underline{F}|\cos\theta \times |\underline{d}| = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\). Is liye work bas force aur displacement ka dot product hai. \(\underline{d}\) shuru wale point se aakhri point tak ka vector hai (head minus tail). Teeno forces ka resultant le kar ek hi dot product karenge.

Resultant force
\[\underline{F} = (10 + 4 - 2)\underline{i} + (-1 + 5 + 1)\underline{j}\]
\[\quad + (11 + 9 - 9)\underline{k}\]
\[= 12\underline{i} + 5\underline{j} + 11\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Har simt ke components alag alag jama kiye: \(\underline{i}\) mein 12, \(\underline{j}\) mein 5, \(\underline{k}\) mein 11.
Dhyan dein: \(-\underline{j}\) ka coefficient \(-1\) hai, aur \(\underline{j}\) ka 1; inhein bhoolna aam ghalti hai.

Displacement
\[\underline{d} = (6 - 5)\underline{i} + (2 + 5)\underline{j} + (-2 + 7)\underline{k}\]
\[= \underline{i} + 7\underline{j} + 5\underline{k}\]
Kyun: Displacement 'aakhri point minus pehla point' hota hai, component by component. Ulta minus karein to har sign ulat jayega aur work ka sign bhi ghalat aayega.
Dhyan dein: Minus ka minus plus: \(5 - (-3) = 8\).

Work done
\[W = (12)(1) + (5)(7) + (11)(5)\]
\[= 12 + 35 + 55 = 102\]
Kyun: \(W = \underline{F}\cdot\underline{d}\), matching components ka product jama kiya. Jawab wohi aaya jo sawal mein diya tha. Work ek scalar hai (sirf number, koi simt nahi), is liye jawab mein \(\underline{i}\), \(\underline{j}\), \(\underline{k}\) nahi aate. Force newton mein aur faasla metre mein ho to work ki unit Nm (joule) hoti hai.

Tasdeeq: har force ka work alag
\[(10, -1, 11)\cdot(1, 7, 5) = 10 - 7 + 55 = 58\]
\[(4, 5, 9)\cdot(1, 7, 5) = 4 + 35 + 45 = 84\]
\[(-2, 1, -9)\cdot(1, 7, 5) = -2 + 7 - 45 = -40\]
\[58 + 84 - 40 = 102 \;\checkmark\]
Kyun: Har force ka work alag nikal kar jama kiya to bhi 102 aaya. Teesri force ka work negative hai: is ka matlab hai ke yeh force harkat ke khilaf (obtuse angle par) kaam kar rahi hai. Negative work bilkul mumkin hai.
blocks.final_answer: Saabit ho gaya: kul work done \(= 102\) Nm.
